content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Richland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to ensure you meet education and hours requirements before enrolling in the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all sessions synchronously, participate in case studies, and engage with active certified practitioners. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement for PMP application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp training, apply directly to PMI with documentation of your education, work experience, and contact hours. Pay the examination fee to activate your application. PMI will verify your credentials and grant eligibility to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce PMBOK concepts. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE, then sit for the computer-based test on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, renew your PMP every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or professional contributions. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your certification current and your skills sharp.
